question: Which compound can be considered as a dehydration reagent?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Concentrated sulfuric acid**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Concentrated sulfuric acid** is commonly used as a dehydration reagent in chemical reactions.
 
• It effectively removes water (H₂O) from compounds, facilitating various organic reactions.
 
• In the presence of concentrated sulfuric acid, alcohols can be dehydrated to form alkenes, which is a typical example of its use.
 
• Other options listed, such as ethanol, ethanoic acid, and ethene, do not function as dehydration reagents.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Sulfuric acid** (H₂SO₄) is a strong acid known for its dehydrating properties.
 
• It is widely used in industrial processes, including the production of fertilizers, chemicals, and in petroleum refining.
 
• In the laboratory, concentrated sulfuric acid is also used in the synthesis of esters, and in the preparation of dyes and explosives.
 
• Due to its highly corrosive nature, concentrated sulfuric acid must be handled with care, using appropriate safety measures.
